definitions.explanation: A cream applied to the skin to chemically dissolve and remove body hair. Applied, left for a few minutes, then wiped off along with the hair. Used as an alternative to shaving or waxing.

examples.japanese: {除毛|じょもう}クリームで{足|あし}の{毛|け}を{処理|しょり}した。
examples.english: I removed the hair on my legs with depilatory cream.

examples.japanese: {除毛|じょもう}クリームは{肌|はだ}が{弱|よわ}い{人|ひと}には{合|あ}わない{場合|ばあい}がある。
examples.english: Hair removal cream may not be suitable for people with sensitive skin.

examples.japanese: {除毛|じょもう}クリームを{使|つか}う{前|まえ}に、{必|かなら}ずパッチテストをしてください。
examples.english: Before using hair removal cream, be sure to do a patch test.

notes:
Combines {除毛|じょもう} (hair removal, from {除|のぞ}く + {毛|け}) and クリーム (cream). A common consumer beauty product available at drugstores and convenience stores.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {除毛|じょもう}クリームを{塗|ぬ}る: to apply hair removal cream
- {除毛|じょもう}クリームで{処理|しょり}する: to treat with depilatory cream

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {脱毛|だつもう}クリーム: depilatory cream — similar term, slightly more clinical
- ワックス{脱毛|だつもう}: waxing — removes hair at the root
